Trace the state of the array [40, 30, 20, 10] after each insertion pass from index 1 to index 3:
(A) Initial state: [40] is sorted; unsorted segment is [30, 20, 10]
(B) Pass 1 (key=30): Shift 40 right, insert 30 -> Array: [30, 40, 20, 10]
(C) Pass 2 (key=20): Shift 40 and 30 right, insert 20 -> Array: [20, 30, 40, 10]
(D) Pass 3 (key=10): Shift 40, 30, and 20 right, insert 10 -> Array: [10, 20, 30, 40]

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Insertion sort passes: start [40] -> insert 30 yields [30,40] -> insert 20 yields [20,30,40] -> insert 10 yields [10,20,30,40].
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
